associations.rationale: The type directly gives an FDRep tensor-product isomorphism for two character representations, with product character on the right.
The type directly states the tensor-product decomposition of two R_z-type representations as a family of copies of the R_{zw}-type representation.
The type directly states the same R_z tensor-product decomposition using a categorical biproduct.
The type directly states that tensoring a character representation with an R_z-type representation is isomorphic to that R_z-type representation.
The type directly states the character-character tensor-product isomorphism with the product character.
The type directly states the tensor-product decomposition into the family of all one-dimensional character representations when zw = 1.
The type directly states the same one-dimensional-character decomposition as a categorical biproduct.
